resources.string: Public address
Nodes and standby panels use it to connect to this panel

An IP address or domain, without the port. Nodes connect to the panel at public address:panel port, and install commands use the same address, so it must be reachable from all nodes. Online nodes receive a new address and use it when they next reconnect. Nodes that are offline during the change must be updated by running nagi panel add on the node.
Domain
The panel is available at https://%1$s
Not bound. Available at https://<public address>:<port>
Bind
Unbind
Unbind %1$s? The panel will no longer be available at this domain, and pages open on it will disconnect.

The domain must already resolve to this machine. Caddy on this machine then proxies the panel on ports 80 and 443 and obtains a certificate automatically. Nodes still connect through the public address and panel port.
Panel master key
Back it up separately
Secure entrance
On. Keep a record of the entrance address
Off. When on, only the address with the entrance path opens the sign-in page
Turn off secure entrance
Turn off the secure entrance? Anyone will be able to open the sign-in page.
Secure entrance is on
From now on, the sign-in page opens only at this address. Keep it safe. If you forget it, run nagi reset entrance on the panel machine.
Done
